g.text: Joining and inviting are separate use cases.
Use the already full, configured match
No boneyard; holder of 6|6 opens with 6|6
If no double was dealt: highest total pips
opens; break ties by highest end.
Keep undealt tiles in the boneyard;
highest dealt double opens with that double
advance to next seat; reset consecutive passes
Display board, own hand and active seat
Place: owned tile matches selected end.
Draw: individual variant, no legal placement,
Pass: no legal placement and no stock.
Receive an action from any participant;
leave board, hands, turn and passes unchanged
Draw one tile into active player's hand
No legal tile and stock remains?
Show updated hand and stock count;
keep same turn for placement or pass
Place tile; remove it from hand;
lowest personal pips (2/3) or team pips (4) wins;
Make accepted state available to all participants;
show each player only their own hand
Display winner or tie and end reason;
show pip totals for a blocked result
Client success requires a confirmed server response.
Missing delivery is not a server rejection or rollback.
